definitions.explanation: A formal act or series of acts performed according to a prescribed order, often with religious or cultural significance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦{式|しき}→式：02000_shiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{神道|しんとう}→神道：09586_shintou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{儀式|ぎしき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The wedding was held according to Shinto ritual.

examples.japanese: {儀式|ぎしき}的な⟦{意味合|いみあ}い→意味合い：09590_imiai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
examples.english: It has a strong ceremonial significance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{伝|つた}わる→伝わる：01961_tsutawaru⟧{儀式|ぎしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{再現|さいげん}した→再現：09777_saigen⟧。
examples.english: We recreated rituals passed down from ancient times.

notes:
TYPES OF CEREMONIES:
- ⟦{宗教|しゅうきょう}→宗教：03208_shuukyou⟧{儀式|ぎしき} (religious ceremony)
- ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧{儀式|ぎしき} (wedding ceremony)
- {葬|そう}{儀式|ぎしき} (funeral rites)
- ⟦{通過|つうか}→通過：03506_tsuuka⟧{儀式|ぎしき}/⟦{通過儀礼|つうかぎれい}→通過儀礼：24879_tsuukagirei⟧ (rites of passage)
- ⟦{成人|せいじん}→成人：03378_seijin⟧{儀式|ぎしき} (coming-of-age ceremony)

ADJECTIVAL USE:
- {儀式|ぎしき}{的|てき} (ceremonial, ritualistic)
- {儀式|ぎしき}{張|ば}る (to be formal/ceremonious)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {式|しき} (ceremony - simpler, often in compounds)
- ⟦{式典|しきてん}→式典：09526_shikiten⟧ (ceremony - formal event)
- ⟦{儀礼|ぎれい}→儀礼：25309_girei⟧ (etiquette, ceremony - formal)
- ⟦{祭礼|さいれい}→祭礼：19752_sairei⟧ (festival rites)

CULTURE: Japan has many traditional ceremonies throughout the year, including ⟦{七五三|しちごさん}→七五三：06185_shichigosan⟧ (Shichi-Go-San), ⟦{成人式|せいじんしき}→成人式：05494_seijinshiki⟧ (Coming of Age Day), and various Shinto rituals.
